entities.summary: Khajag Barsamian is an Armenian Orthodox Archbishop who has served as the pontifical legate of Western Europe and representative of the Armenian Apostolic Church to the Holy See since 2018. He was previously the Armenian Primate of America (Eastern) from 1990 to 2018.
